acquisition.method: Acquisition run 2, separate from run 1 (2026-10-07, 22:07 UTC, three other cases; not repeated or changed): downloaded with curl on 2026-10-07 between 22:48:24 and 22:50:20 UTC, one keyless HTTPS GET per case window from the Federal Reserve Board's Data Download Program direct-download address for the same package of exactly the two H.15 series, at most three attempts per case, five seconds apart. No API key, cookies or FRED request were used. A reply was kept only if it was a non-empty text/csv with HTTP status 200; six first attempts received an empty text/html reply and are recorded as discarded in this run's acquisition record.
acquisition.tool: curl 8.21.0 (Windows) libcurl/8.21.0 Schannel zlib/1.3.2 WinIDN WinLDAP
acquisition.vintage_note: No vintage was requested, and the Data Download Program offers none: its help page says data are only available as currently published and that pre-revision or real-time data are not available. These are the Board's values when retrieved, which may differ from those available on the publication date; whether any of them was revised is not known from this download.
